_doc: Every component the manager installs, each with its own version (docs/MANAGER.md, 'Components'). Bump a component's version when its files change: tools\release.ps1 refuses a changed component whose version is the one already released, and publishes only the components whose version is new. 'changelog' is what the manager shows for this version. 'min_manager_version' (here as the default, or per component) is the oldest manager that may install it. The loader is the proxy dll; data is data/ (presets, supported_exe.txt, install_rules.json, icon_pack.json) and the settings schema's input names; a mod is atmt_mods/<name>.dll, its ini template if mods/*/<name>.ini exists, and its part of dist/settings_schema.json. A built dll not listed under mods ships nowhere.
